name: Yaku ~Yuujou Dangi~
source:
After an incident, a certain elementary school was closed...
What happened has remained shrouded in darkness...
One night, give former pupils met at the abandoned school to fulfill a promise they made to each other...
What will happen now...?
What strange events will occur...?

[From the manual]
